Continue Phase 1 only. Build manager review found mandatory issues; fix before signoff:
1. analyzer.feed grows terms/tfs/map without a byte budget; MaxBufferBytes currently enforced only at commit. Bound per-document analyzer memory during tokenization, reject oversized documents early with ErrDocTooLarge. Pass the configured limit to each analyzer; account for terms and arrays conservatively, discard oversized pooled backing storage. Add a regression with many distinct terms, not just commit-limit tests.
2. Index.Search allocates one large scratch per simultaneous caller without admission control. Add configurable bounded search slots (channel) and context-aware admission. Close must wake queued callers safely; ensure no deadlock and preserve concurrent Close correctness. Test cancellations while queued and maximum admitted concurrency.
3. NewWriter allows two instances to overwrite segment names before manifest publication. Acquire an exclusive directory writer lock atomically and release on Close/error cleanup. Refuse existing segment files from abandoned builds, rather than overwrite mmap-visible files. Test competing writers and failure cleanup. Document crash-recovery behavior.
4. User explicitly requires SIMD integer bit-packing. Implement real amd64 SSE2 SIMD kernels (SSE2 baseline avoids external dependency/runtime CPU detection) for byte-aligned widths 8 and 16 at minimum, with scalar fallback for all other widths/platforms. Wire packing AND unpacking into AppendPFOR/DecodePFOR, test against independent scalar implementation for all lengths incl tail and all widths, verify generated machine instructions via go tool objdump. Document precise supported SIMD widths; do not claim all widths SIMD. Include benchmark comparisons with matched inputs. No fake or no-op SIMD.
5. DeltaEncodeStrict/DeltaDecodeStrict exported next uint64 can overflow when next is MaxUint64; reject invalid next before arithmetic (valid next <= 2^32). Add overflow regression tests.
6. SECChunk.Tokens says authoritative token stream but is retokenized: clarify or preserve intended semantics consistently. Text is currently not stored; explicitly document that callers need a separate disk-backed passage store for RAG and this Phase 1 only retrieves metadata, unless you implement a bounded disk-backed passage store now. Do not claim end-to-end RAG readiness.
Run go test ./..., go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., benchmarks -benchmem after edits. Store raw genuine benchmark and validation output in docs/build/ with environment and fixture caveats, update phase1.md and README to final implementation. Do not commit/push or touch protected dirs. No later phases.
